data.description: Diesel fuel runs the Excavator and quarries, and each collectable barrel gives you 1. The easiest pickups with no puzzle are [Junkyard](/monument/junkyard) with about 3 and [Radtown](/monument/radtown) with 2, while Large Oil Rig has 4 and Oil Rig about 2. Airfield, Power Plant, Water Treatment Plant, Missile Silo and [The Dome](/monument/the-dome) keep theirs behind puzzles, and so do 2 of [Military Tunnel](/monument/military-tunnel)'s 3. Outpost also sells 1 for 300 low grade.
